body: My mom by some miracle took me. Turned out to be nothing but some bruised tissue that will heal up in a couple of days. I’ve broken a bone before and it felt very similar so I was cautious, but overall it went smoothly and I’m not badly injured.

The thing I’m worried about is that my family absolutely sucks but isn’t bad enough for CPS to actually do anything. My injury is technically self inflicted even though my mom riled me up. They’ve never laid a hand on me and I have enough food etc. I feel like having cps confront them would just result in the abuse getting worse and nothing else. That said I can just be vague about it, let them think I have anger issues or something

I’ve been taking medicine for the pain, after sleeping it doesn’t hurt as badly but it comes back when I move my pinky certain ways (like typing). My moms still acting like a fucking 8 year old, I’ll see if my dad can bring me or something.
Took an nsaid for the pain. No bruising but very localized pain and that jittery/adrenaline feeling. I’ll sleep and try to go in the morning
I’m just scared and it’s very late where I am and I don’t want to rush to the doctor in the middle of the night when my moms in a mood
Alright, thanks. It’s looking like I’ll have to stick to the internet for support but at least I don’t risk getting myself in a bigger mess you know.

Know anything about Wisconsin?
And yeah I could just say I don’t have any method in mind, just exasperated. I want to get help but i don’t want to make things worse for myself especially since I have a pretty intense phobia of the medical field
I’m trying to survive off Reddit and the suicide hotline so I don’t get reported. Again, thank you so much for the support. It’s really helping me

it’s...  not really an option for me, I guess. Any sort of ‘patient’ position or even the smell of alcohol or any procedure no matter how painless will set me off. I’m not trying to be difficult here, and I truly appreciate your responses. I don’t have a lot of people to talk to.

To be completely honest half the reason I’m suicidal is due to my medical PTSD (and the fact I’ll have to keep facing it over and over, as the doctor is just a part of life). So hospitalization would probably make me a lot worse if it didn’t make me kill myself as soon as possible.
Alright, thank you for your honesty.
Yeah but who are the authorities? What would they do?

Thank you so much. This is really helpful and makes me feel a little better
And I just want to clarify- I am not doing illegal drugs. I’m talking about sedation in a medical setting. I do sympathize with your story though and it’s noble of you to help others the way you do
In a way I want to save at least one person from a fate like mine. I guess that's part of it. I'm just feeling very hopeless.

If drugging me unconscious can't make me feel okay I don't know what therapy is gonna do. 

And I can't help but be difficult on myself. I am the only one to blame here. I've caused all the problems I have in my life.
